task:
Draw: a factory window with a segmental brick arch on top and a grid of small panes.
It belongs to a district of the town with this look, which every part of the district shares: a former industrial quarter that is turning into offices: red and brown brick, dark steel frames, riveted iron, weathered green and rust-red paint, grey concrete; plain sturdy shapes, still friendly and cartoon-like, here and there a weed.
